He began his career at Citibank in Frankfurt, working across consumer finance, corporate and investment banking and financial control, before joining Barclays as managing director for the Middle East and North Africa. He joined Mastercard in 2010 to lead its Middle East and Africa operations, became chief product officer in 2016, president in 2020 and then chief executive officer in 2021.
